title: Room Hire
text: The clubrooms at 12 Thomas Street, Murray Bridge SA 5253 are available for hire. You can request either of our two halls using the enquiry form below.

title: Room Hire
text:
Choose a hall

  
    Large Hall
    Up to 80 people seated
    Suitable for larger functions, workshops and community gatherings.
    
      Photographs of the Large Hall will be added here.
    
    Select Large Hall for enquiry
  
  
    Small Hall
    Up to 25 people seated
    Suitable for smaller meetings, board games and club catch-ups.
    
      Photographs of the Small Hall will be added here.
    
    Select Small Hall for enquiry
  


Included facilities
Use of the kitchen, wheelchair-accessible entrances, accessible toilets and accessible parking is included with hall hire.


Fees
Standard hall hire rates apply. An additional cleaning fee may be charged if required. Please submit an enquiry for the applicable fees and confirmation of availability.

title: Murray Bridge news
text:
Headlines are pulled from public sources for Murray Bridge, South Australia. Last fetched 2026-11-11 06:30 UTC. Follow the link for the full story.
Club items stay on the News page. Local sources: Rural City of Murray Bridge, Murray Valley Standard, Murray Bridge News, SA Police.

title: Murray Bridge news
text:
Rural City of Murray Bridge

2026-11-03 — 2025-26 Annual Report Annual Report highlights a busy year for Murray Bridge, with community achievements, infrastructure improvements and continued investment across the region.
2026-11-05 — Celebrating inclusion and connection this International Day of People with Disability The Rural City of Murray Bridge is inviting the community to a free community event on Friday 4 December 2026 to celebrate inclusion, connection and the contributions of people with disability.
2026-09-13 — Sturt Reserve riverfront transformation endorsed Council has endorsed concept designs for a $34 million transformation of the town’s riverfront. The Sturt Reserve project will deliver new recreation, play and historic precincts, following endorsement of the Sturt Reserve Masterplan in 2017.

title: Murray Bridge news
text:
SA Police — Murray Mallee

2026-10-22 — Body located at Murray Bridge Police are preparing a report for the Coroner after a man’s body was discovered at Murray Bridge. Police were called to a rural property on Ridge Road about 6pm on Wednesday 21 October after the body of a man was located.
2026-10-19 — Body found in water at Murray Bridge Police are preparing a report for the Coroner after a man’s body was found at Murray Bridge. The deceased person was later identified as a 78-year-old Victor Harbor man.

title: Murray Bridge news
section: South Australian Government and Regional Development
text:
South Australian Government and Regional Development

2026 — Tourism and accommodation boost for Riverland and Murraylands The Albanese Government will contribute $1.75 million to a new tourism offering at Murray Bridge — Bridge Watersport Park. The project will deliver the state’s first-ever cable wakeboard park, featuring a permanent aqua park and retail and cafe facilities.
2026 — Sturt Reserve to secure $4.85 million Upgrade A re-elected Albanese Labor Government will deliver $4.85 million for the redevelopment of the Sturt Reserve Precinct. The Pondi Play Space will turn the underutilised reserve into a play precinct for children and families, with a safe, inclusive and accessible open leisure space.
2026 — Climate-resilient planting being pioneered in Murray Bridge The first trial of its kind in South Australia is underway in Murray Bridge, showcasing how native plantings can deliver cooler, greener, and more climate-resilient streetscapes. The woody meadows project is a 5-year trial testing climate-resilient local native plants in hot, dry urban conditions. Visit the site on Swanport Road.
2026-08-11 — Australia Post opens new Murray Bridge delivery centre Australia Post has opened a new, purpose-built delivery centre in Murray Bridge, the second of four new facilities opening as part of an investment to modernise its delivery network across regional South Australia. The 1,143m2 site can process up to 2,600 parcels per day. Postal services continue at the nearby Murray Bridge Post Office and Murray Bridge South LPO.

title: Murray Bridge news
text:
Community and Events

2026-11-21 — The Murray Bridge Christmas Pageant SAVE THE DATE: The Murray Bridge Christmas Pageant returns Saturday 21 November 2026.
2026-11-21 — MB Riverfront Christmas Festival 2026 Saturday 21 November: 11am - 9pm at Sturt Reserve, Murray Bridge. The Kookaburra Homes Murray Bridge Riverfront Christmas Festival is a FREE annual community event incorporating the community Christmas Parade and Spry Holdings Skyshow.
2026-11-13 — Drag Bingo Night at The Square Drag Bingo Night on 13 November from 6PM to 9PM at The Square Murray Bridge. Free with bookings essential, includes grazing food.
2026-11-09 — Murray Bridge Regatta results Results from the Murray Bridge Regatta, including the 3 Mile Eight handicapped race. Riverside Rowing Club won in 21:29.3, ahead of Adelaide University and Prince Alfred College.
2026-11-02 — Murray Bridge Community Centre Monday programs Free and low-cost Monday community programs run by Murray Bridge Community Centre Inc. Crochet Mondays 1-3pm at 18 Beatty Terrace for $2 per session, plus woodburning, Social Walking Netball, Dementia Connection Cafe and Yoga with Jo.

title: Murray Bridge news
text:
Business and Development

2026 — Murray Bridge Marina & Camping Park changes hands The freehold going concern of Murray Bridge Marina & Camping and Caravan Park, a 12-hectare property along the Murray River, has been sold. Located 75 kilometres southeast of Adelaide, the park features 156 accommodations, including 82 caravan sites, 11 cabins, 60 marina berths, and three houseboats. Acquired by the Orken family.
2026 — Ray White in Strathalbyn and Murray Bridge join forces Donna and Richard Ytsma have handed over the reins of their Ray White Murray Bridge office to Mr Bagley, who has been operating the Ray White Strathalbyn business since 2022. Murray Bridge is described as still affordable, with an influx of younger buyers, investors, first home buyers and family buyers.
2026 — Lions Club of Murray Bridge marks 20 years of sweet support for Meals on Wheels Lions Club of Murray Bridge marks 20 years of support for Meals on Wheels, as reported in Murray Bridge News / The Murray Valley Standard.

2026-10-03 — St Lawrence back on top in Murray Bridge Gold Cup St Lawrence scored his first black-type success in the A$150,000 Listed Carlton Draught Murray Bridge Gold Cup (1600m) at Murray Bridge.
2026-11-06 — Murray Bridge greyhound racing results Friday, November 6, 2026 Murray Bridge race results, including the Daish Irrigation and Fodder (Straight) Stake.

title: Radio Club meeting times, all are welcome!
text:
Our Radio club (which is affiliated with the Adelaide Hills Amateur Radio Society) meets at 7:00 p.m. on the second and fourth Wednesdays each month at the “Combined clubs” in Johnstone Park, Murray Bridge.
The entrance to Johnstone Park, which houses our club rooms, is at 12 Thomas Street, Murray Bridge.
Anyone with an interest in radio communications is welcome.
We look forward to seeing you there!
